Assimilative Evolution

Primal Zergs (Starcraft 2) can consume other life forms and assimilate their useful genetic traits into a more powerful form.

Power/Ability to:

Evolve by absorbing and consuming.
"Every living thing you consume makes you stronger. You take their shapes, and you take their memories."
― Alex Mercer to James Heller, Prototype 2

The ability to evolve by absorbing and consuming. Variation of Absorption. Combination of Digestive Assimilation and Evolution.

Also Called[]

  • Absorption/Biological/Consumptive/Digestive/Organic Evolution

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb targets, including beings or items, in order to gain abilities, traits, attributes, or other properties from them. They can assimilate in order to survive anything. This usually involves absorbing materials such as organic biomass, but it can also involve absorbing some form of energy.

Limitations[]

  • Certain targets may be difficult to absorb.
  • May only have certain traits until new ones are absorbed, especially if the new trait renders the previous one obsolete.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation

Gallery[]

Anime/Manga/Manhwa/Manhua[]

While users of any of The Nine Titans (Attack on Titan) can gain the powers of the others by devouring them...
...The Female Titan is most adept at this, easily able to mimic the other Eight Titan's powers by only consuming part of them.
Aaroniero Arruruerie (Bleach) is a unique Hollow (now an Arrancar) who gains all the powers, memories, and skills of any Hollow he cannibalizes, thus allowing him to evolve endlessly.
Ikomikidomoe (Bleach) can evolve endlessly by breaking down and integrating the full spiritual power of anything it devours, growing exponentially stronger without limit.
Pernida Parnkgjas (Bleach) can, amongst other methods, keep evolving through assimilating other beings into itself.
Eaters (Digimon) are named such not just because of their endless hunger for data, but also because they can evolve without limit through assimilation.
Cell (Dragon Ball Z) is able to increase power by absorbing others...
...and obtained his perfect form by absorbing Androids 17 and 18.
Moro (Dragon Ball Super) swallows Seven-Three whole...
...gaining the android's copied power, including Moro's own.
Franmalth (Fairy Tail) can evolve by absorbing the souls of other beings.
Tamaki Amajiki's Chimera (My Hero Academia)
Meruem (Hunter X Hunter) consumes the flesh of a Nen user, assimilating their aura and powers.
By repeatedly consuming other Ghouls, Ken Kaneki (Tokyo Ghoul) assimilated enough Rc cells to mutate into a powerful Kakuja.
Kapellmeister (Marchen Awakens Romance) transformed into a demonic being after absorbing his own Ghost Chess henchmen.
By continually absorbing/consuming other monsters, Alucard (Rosario + Vampire) evolved into a creature powerful enough to destroy the world.
Gourmet Cells (Toriko) evolve when their user consumes delicious foods that suit them and the 'tastes' of the cells, enhancing the strength of the user and their abilities.

Comics[]

Predator X's (Marvel Comics) genetics were left intentionally incomplete, allowing its DNA strand to evolve with every meal. This allows for increased size and the formation of defensive attributes against powers similar to its victim's.
An Eater that has assimilated multiple humans, therefore, becomes much more humanoid in appearance.

Movies[]

The Thing (John Carpenter's The Thing)
Long One (Slither)

Video Games[]

Aldrich, Devourer of Gods (Dark Souls III), is strongly implied to have assimilated the frail remains of Gwendoline, Nito, and Priscilla, creating the form that he has now.
Android 21 (Dragon Ball Fighter Z) evolved and obtained an entirely new level of power after absorbing Cell.
Mira (Dragon Ball Xenoverse) ascends to his Final Form by absorbing his creator, Towa, and Tokitoki's egg.
Bass.EXE (Mega Man Battle Network) evolved and obtained godlike power by absorbing the deleted data of viruses and other Navis.
Dehaka (Starcraft) is a notable Primal Zerg who can evolve by assimilation.
The Goliath (Evolve) is one of the monsters that are able to gain life, armor, and abilities and grow in power by eating other life forms.
